text: Kate Fleming, Program Director, Low Carbon Cities Canada (LC3), and Mary Pickering, Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships, Toronto Atmospheric Fund will jointly provide an overview of the LC3 Network and National Office, detailing purpose, roles and responsibilities, and leveraging opportunities designed to enhance resources and outcomes for Toronto Atmospheric Fund and other LC3 Network members across Canada.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
